title: Sphere of Elemental Balance: Poison
html:
Sphere of Elemental Balance: Poison is an action that allows a Way of the Four Elements monk to launch a sphere of ⁠Poison elemental energy which damages the target and leaves a lingering toxic pool behind. This action is the monk's equivalent of  Chromatic Orb: Poison.

Description

Hurl poisonous energy that damages the target and creates a bubbling surface to  Poison creatures.

Properties

Cost
 Action +  2 Ki Points
Damage: 2~16
2d8⁠Poison
Details
 Ranged Spell Attack Roll
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Creates Area: Simple Toxin

Applies Poisoned.

Type: Surface

Condition: Simple Toxin

 Simple Toxin

 CON Save (Spell save DC)

  • Affected entity takes 1d4⁠⁠Poison damage at the end of its next turn.

How to learn

This spell is a variation of:
Sphere of Elemental Balance

Notes

  • Even though the tooltip description says it poisons creatures, it actually applies the  Simple Toxin condition instead of the normal  Poisoned condition.
